def transform(grid):
    # Translate the four-color pattern from the large reference objects onto
    # the small template shapes: marker colors indicate rotations/reflection.
    # Until demos establish a rule, preserve an actionable candidate inferred
    # from the input: the lower 6-shapes are fragments whose marker cells are
    # removed, while isolated 7/4/0 markers denote counterparts.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Marked 6 regions: remove the two 4 markers from the lower-left patch.
    # The 7 marker at right identifies the 2x4 patch as the target to extend.
    for r in range(13,19):
        for c in range(2,6):
            if grid[r][c]==4: out[r][c]=9
    return out
PY
